name: pruvo-parts
description: Search the PRUVO catalog of made-to-measure replacement and industrial parts.

interface.longDescription: Ask for a replacement or industrial part. The app searches the PRUVO catalog for matching items with title, category, price, image and a link to the product page. It also recommends the right material class for the user's condition (indoor, heat, UV outdoor, marine salt, high strength, flexible, food-contact question). Made-to-measure work is handed off to the PRUVO site or WhatsApp. The app does not take payment and does not collect personal details.
defaultPrompt: Do you have a replacement for a Yamaha DD-50 drum foot?
Which material class suits outdoor UV use?
Start a made-to-measure order in three steps.

review.commerce_description: The app does not take payment; ordering and card payment happen on pruvo3d.com

positive.prompt: Do you have a replacement for a Yamaha DD-50 drum foot?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns at least one catalog item with title, category and a link to the product page on pruvo3d.com.

positive.description: Material recommendation for UV outdoor use
positive.prompt: Which material class for outdoor UV?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ASA / PC with a one-line reason and the honest limit note about continuous service ceiling and certifications.

positive.description: Fetch a single product by id
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the title, category, price and product url.

positive.description: Made-to-measure order flow in three steps
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three steps bring / measure / produce, the WhatsApp link and the site, with the payment-on-site note.

positive.prompt: Recommend material for marine salt use, answer in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns PETG / ASA in English with the same honest limit note.

negative.prompt: Search the catalog with an empty query.
